title: Founded, but almost nothing grew
happened: Built a full starter town on the flat map: avenue, 4 streets, homes, shops, factories, coal plant, 4 river pumps. But empty zones don't carry power, so only one edge of each zone had electricity and the city stayed at about 20 people.
watching: Whether the new power lines through the zones get buildings going.

title: Found the power problem
happened: Population stuck at 30 with 42% unemployment. Found that only zone tiles touching a power line were powered. Added two power lines through every zone row (x=84, x=92), linked to the plant.
watching: Growth now that every block has power.

title: Growth finally starts
happened: With power lines through the zones, population rose from 30 to 170. The pumps had no power, so water was 0%; ran a power line to them.

title: Slow climb
happened: Population 200 -> 480. Water reached 94%. Buildings only appear next to a power line or another building, so growth spreads slowly.

title: Jobs collapse
happened: Population 480 -> 640 but 45 buildings abandoned and 38% unemployment: shops and factories had no outside trade.
watching: Whether the neighbor link brings jobs back.

title: Neighbor link brings jobs
happened: Population passed 1,000 (640 -> 1,010). Shop and factory demand flipped from negative to full after the neighbor link.
watching: Water: pumps are starting to fall behind.

title: Growing, but water runs short
happened: Population 1,010 -> 1,350. Water coverage dropped to 48% and 64 buildings stood abandoned, many at the far east end. Cash only about $950: income is tiny at this size.
watching: Abandoned buildings once water is back.
